name: 23rd-padel-electron
description: 23rd Padel offline desktop app with Electron, Django, React, and SQLite

scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && CI=false npm run build
scripts.build:backend:mac: cd backend && PYINSTALLER_CONFIG_DIR=/private/tmp/23rd-padel-pyinstaller-cache python3 -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --distpath dist --workpath build/pyinstaller 23rd-padel-backend.spec
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && DATA_USE_SQLITE=1 python3 manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000
scripts.migrate: cd backend && DATA_USE_SQLITE=1 python3 manage.py migrate
scripts.bootstrap: cd backend && DATA_USE_SQLITE=1 python3 manage.py bootstrap_offline
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend:mac && electron-forge package --platform=darwin
scripts.make:dmg: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend:mac && electron-forge make --platform=darwin --targets=@electron-forge/maker-dmg
